description: Defines the Allocator interface for memory management, including methods for allocation, deallocation, and capacity tracking.

classes.name: Allocator
classes.description: Abstract base class providing a standard interface for memory allocators, including methods for allocating, freeing, and querying memory.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of specified size without alignment constraints.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of specified size with specified alignment.

methods.name: AllocateForAlignment
methods.description: Allocates memory suitable for a specific alignment, possibly returning a non-aligned pointer with size set to the allocated size.

methods.name: FreeWithSize
methods.description: Frees memory with specified size, default implementation delegates to Free.

methods.name: GetCapacity
methods.description: Returns total capacity available for allocations.

methods.name: PrintAllocations
methods.description: Prints information about all current allocations.
